- Windows desktops: a file opens in a window of its own (pictures, videos, music, PDF and text are shown there), in every Windows look.
- Windows 7 and 11: the windows are see-through over the blurred desktop, File Explorer's bars too; Windows 11 Settings is see-through.
- Joke apps: small popup windows, their own group at the end of Programs and Start, and off the phone looks' app list.
- File manager: a long press picks the row and goes straight into the slide selection.
- Downloads: a big file is fetched in eight parts at once.
- Share window: a stream opened from a player app (Stremio's external player) shows its Download button at once.
- Blended player: a pulled-down player is a sheet with rounded corners and a pill bar.
- Look picker: the cards keep one size in every row.
- Keyboard clipboard: an upright HEIC photo stays upright.
